smyx-elderly-drinking-frequency-analysis 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Analyzes living room/kitchen camera video to detect cup pickup/putdown events as an indirect measure of elderly water intake.
- Automatically counts daily cup pickups and generates structured daily hydration reports.
- Triggers dehydration risk alerts and sends mobile app reminders if drinking frequency falls below a preset threshold.
- Supports integration with home-care cameras and community health-management platforms.
- Offers precise rules for user identification (open-id) and secure data handling for historical reports.
